key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Group net turnover decreased 4% to EUR 25.99 million with a loss of EUR 643,000 (compared to EUR 2.37 million loss prior year). Parent company net turnover decreased 6% to EUR 21.92 million with a loss of EUR 552,000 (compared to EUR 1.34 million loss prior year).

Regional revenue changes: Americas region turnover decreased 14% to EUR 14.17 million (55% of group turnover), Europe region turnover increased 17% to EUR 10.0 million, Asia/TMiddle East/Africa region turnover decreased 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

Impact of geopolitical factors: Ongoing US-China trade tensions affect global electronics markets but currently have no significant negative impact on group sales; import duties remain unchanged for microwave equipment imported to the US from the EU, while Aranet products face a 15% duty; Canada branch established to mitigate supply chain and customs cost risks.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (ģeopolitiskie riski un muitas nodokļi)

key_information_units.information: Product development and strategic focus: Continued investment in new product development (micro-wave data transmission, IoT solutions like Aranet), initiation of faster-to-implement product development initiatives, and market research to identify problem areas for product modifications and next-generation technology prototypes.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (izpēte un attīstība, nākotnes perspektīvas)

key_information_units.information: Liquidity and cash flow position: Group cash balance increased to EUR 4.81 million (up EUR 2.6 million); parent company cash balance increased to EUR 2.84 million (up EUR 1.35 million); unused EUR 4.95 million credit line with Luminor Bank; both group and parent company reported positive operating cash flow.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (naudas līdzekļu atlikums), Naudas plūsmu pārskats

key_information_units.information: Segment and geographic revenue distribution: Business divided into two segments - SAF products (CFIP, Integra, Spectrum Compact, Aranet) dominating revenue, and other products (antennas, cables, OEM); exports account for 97% of group turnover (EUR 25.24 million) and 96% of parent turnover (EUR 21.06 million), with products sold in 87 countries.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (eksports), 17. piezīme (segmenti un ģeogrāfiskā sadalījuma informācija)

key_information_units.information: Loss explanation and outlook: Management characterizes the reporting year's loss as temporary and not impacting long-term stability; focuses on strategic market niches for wireless data transmission products and specialized solutions.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (zaudējumu situācijas vērtējums un nākotnes plāni)

key_information_units.information: Proposal to cover loss: Board of Directors proposes to cover the reporting year's loss from retained earnings of previous years.
